classes.name: Ringside
classes.description: Sections 3 to 7, floor level, main arena. The ring is a few metres away. You hear the strikes and the corner instructions.

classes.name: Club Class
classes.description: Sections 8 and 9, elevated tier, main arena. Looks down across the whole ring, with the walkouts and corners in view.

classes.name: LEO Section
classes.description: Section 10, elevated tier, main arena, directly facing the front of the ring. The broadcast cameras and commentary team sit here, which tells you how good the front-facing view is.

classes.name: Third Class
classes.description: Section 11, upper tier, the highest point in the stadium. A wide view over the whole arena: ring, walkout, corners and crowd in one picture.
